description: Stat & status cards + activity feed: build DashboardMetricCard (965:5276 Default/Hover), Subscriptions (1049:12356 Active/Expired/Cancelled), HighlightCard (1016:8697 Students/Courses), and ActivityItem feed row (999:7499 Secondary/Error/Warning). These are the simplest composition-only organisms and establish the shared icon-chip + status-color + card-chrome patterns the later features reuse. Depends on FEAT-001 (typography classes + i18n keys). Independent of FEAT-003/004/005.
steps: Read context.json and this file FIRST. For each component below, call get_design_context (fileKey y0eOLyKLtTHnJYzOW046WR) on its node id for exact structure, then ADAPT to tokens/atoms — never paste raw Figma code.

DashboardMetricCard — src/components/organisms/dashboard-metric-card.tsx (node 965:5276). forwardRef<HTMLDivElement>, cva state variant: default = border-border; hover = border-primary-hover + shadow-card. Top row: optional trend Badge variant="secondary" (secondary-light) + metric label (text-body, paragraph-sm medium) + 32px navy icon chip (rounded-sm, bg-primary, inverse icon from an `icon`/`iconSwap` ReactNode prop). Value row: className text-h4-semibold text-accent. Card: rounded-lg + p-6. Props: label, value, trendLabel?, icon?, state?. data-slot + data-state. Logical props only.

Subscriptions — src/components/organisms/subscriptions.tsx (node 1049:12356). forwardRef, cva status variant: active -> bg-secondary-light border-secondary text-secondary + secondary icon chip; expired -> bg-destructive-light-strong border-destructive text-destructive + destructive chip; cancelled -> bg-warning-light border-warning text-warning + warning chip. Header row: label (paragraph-sm medium, status color) + 32px status-surface icon chip (inverse icon). Value row: text-h4-semibold in the status color. rounded-lg + p-6 + border. Props: label, value, status, icon?.

HighlightCard — src/components/organisms/highlight-card.tsx (node 1016:8697). One component, variant students|courses differing by icon/accent only; compact ~400x83 row: icon chip + number (paragraph-lg or H4) + label (text-body). Props: value, label, icon?, variant?. rounded-lg + p-6 + border (+ optional shadow-card).

ActivityItem — src/components/organisms/activity-item.tsx (node 999:7499). forwardRef<HTMLLIElement> rendering <li> (consumers wrap in <ul role="list">). cva status variant secondary|error|warning: leading status dot (12px rounded-md bar in status surface) at block start; text block (name paragraph-sm medium text-primary; meta row = action in status color + 4px separator dot + time in text-muted-foreground); trailing 32px icon chip in status-LIGHT surface with status-colored icon. Props: name, action?, time?, status, icon?, showDot?. Logical props (start/end).
Export all four (+ their *Variants where exported) from src/components/organisms/index.ts.

Add colocated tests (plans-card.test.tsx pattern, render inside NextIntlClientProvider with en.json): dashboard-metric-card.test.tsx, subscriptions.test.tsx, highlight-card.test.tsx, activity-item.test.tsx — assert value/label render, variant/status data attribute, optional badge/icon, and list-item semantics for ActivityItem.
If any i18n fallback strings are needed, add them to organisms.dashboard in BOTH messages/en.json and messages/ar.json in sync.
acceptance_criteria: Four organisms exist, forwardRef, prop-driven, cva variants, logical properties only, light+dark, composed from existing atoms/icons (no duplicated styling).
All four are barrel-exported from src/components/organisms/index.ts.
Colocated unit tests pass and messages-parity stays green.
`npx vitest run src/components/organisms` passes; `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` succeed.
verification: npm run typegen; npm run typecheck
